players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh went 0-for-3 as Mariners fell 6-1 to Chicago. He is 0-for-13 in three games since returning from a right-side injury and batting .170 on the season. Team is easing him back in DH duties.

sources.title: Mariners-White Sox Lineups: Cal Raleigh gets another DH day

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper was removed before his first at-bat Saturday with a migraine, replaced by Felix Reyes. Team expects him available Sunday. This is the third migraine-related absence for a Phillies player in 2026. Harper is batting .285 with 9 HR and 24 RBI.

sources.title: Phillies 1B Bryce Harper exits 9-3 victory with migraine — ESPN

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 1-for-4 while managing a sore right thumb that flared up on the prior road trip. He is day-to-day. His .314 average ranks top-10 in the NL despite the nagging injury.

sources.title: Giants' Luis Arraez: Out again due to sore thumb — CBS Sports

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-3 with a walk in the Mets' 2-1 loss to Arizona. He had a chance with two runners on late but grounded out. Mets offense has been quiet this weekend series.

sources.title: 5/9/2026 Box Score: Arizona Diamondbacks 2 New York Mets 1

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle went 0-for-2 with a HBP and committed his 4th error of the season, but did score a run in the 8th on a Riley Greene double. Tigers fell 5-1 to Kansas City. Michael Wacha won with 6 strong innings.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Crow-Armstrong went 0-for-3 and exited the game after fouling a ball off his right knee, receiving a bruised right knee diagnosis. He is day-to-day. The Cubs were shut out 6-0 by Texas, ending their 10-game win streak.

sources.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong: Exits with bruised knee — CBS Sports

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 1-for-4 as the Padres beat St. Louis 4-2. He had been on a hot May stretch (.471 over 4 games entering Saturday). Padres pitching held the Cardinals in check after a 6-0 shutout loss the night before.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez went 1-for-4 with a run scored, but Dodgers fell 7-2 as Blake Snell's season debut was rough (5 ER in 3 IP). Spencer Strider threw 6 scoreless for Atlanta. Hernandez is fully healthy after battling a groin issue in 2025.

sources.title: Atlanta Braves at Los Angeles Dodgers Game Story — 05/09/2026

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear as Mets fell 2-1. He has had 6 consecutive scoreless outings (8 K, 5.2 IP) after a rough start to the season. ERA stands at 6.00 but trending sharply down. Strong candidate to pick up saves as Mets stabilize.

sources.title: Devin Williams Starting to Turn the Corner — Metsmerized Online

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler did not start Saturday. He returned from thoracic outlet surgery and is 1-0 with a 2.45 ERA in two starts, averaging 93.6 mph on his fastball. His next start is expected this week vs the Athletics.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler makes 2026 debut for Phillies

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans is on the 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload). He exited his May 6 start vs Cleveland in the 3rd inning with triceps/elbow soreness. No timetable for return has been given.

sources.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL With Elbow Impingement — MLB Trade Rumors

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns delivered his 7th quality start in 8 outings: 6 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, 2 K, 3 BB. Win improves him to 4-1 with a 2.12 ERA. Reds snapped an 8-game losing streak 3-1 over Houston. Burns matched his season low with 2 strikeouts but kept the lineup off-balance.

sources.title: Chase Burns' strong start helps Reds snap 8-game skid 3-1 over Astros — Washington Post

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi did not start Saturday — Jack Leiter threw for Texas in the 6-0 shutout of Chicago. Eovaldi owns a 4.15 ERA over 8 starts and his next outing is expected this coming week.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan started Friday May 8 vs Atlanta (4.2 IP, 1 ER, Dodgers won 3-1). Manager Roberts praised his stuff and competitiveness. ERA is 5.22 on the season but he's showing progress. Did not pitch Saturday.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan shows progress, bullpen thrives in Dodgers' win over Braves — Yahoo Sports

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers took the loss Friday May 8 at Toronto (3.2 IP, 2 ER, career-high 6 BB, 2 H). Angels lost 2-0. Falls to 1-2 on the season. Command was an issue with the unusual walk total. Did not pitch Saturday.

sources.title: Los Angeles Angels vs. Toronto Blue Jays Box Score — May 8, 2026 — CBS Sports

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice missed his 4th consecutive game with a left hand contusion suffered fielding a throw from Max Fried vs Baltimore. He is day-to-day and the Yankees do not expect an IL stint. Paul Goldschmidt has taken over at first.

sources.title: Ben Rice hasn't done a lot since hand injury, but Yankees still think he'll avoid IL
